notes.title: "Wooden Floor 2 - Resurrection" now on Greenlight
notes.notes:
Hey guys and gals,

I hope you are ready for the sequel to this! :D

Been working on a sequel to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/348790] "Wooden Floor" [/url] for quite some time already and finally decided that it was about time to set up a Greenlight page for the actual game, as it has just been a concept for some time. It already is in a stage where there is no more doubt about it being released at some point :)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=397679465] Link to Greenlight page of  "Wooden Floor 2 - Resurrection" [/url]

Please check out the game and the info given on the site and vote for it if u like :) There is also a demo giving you a rough look of what the game will be like on IndieDB (Link on Greenlight page)

Hope you will support this game :)

Cheers, Fabian (pheenix93)

notes.title: Wooden Floor Release
notes.notes:
Finally Wooden Floor is coming to Steam Store - Friday the 13th of february. :)
Just wanted to say thanks again to everyone supporting me and the game on its way...
Check out the discussion forums if u need help in the future or have any other questions.

Some info:
- I will work on free Keys for the people waiting for them
- Steam version will be slightly different to other game version (Desura)

Cheers, pheenix
